label: Energy
definition: Buying, selling or hedging electrical energy (MWh) for delivery in a given period.

label: Frequency response
definition: Fast, automatic changes in active power that follow changes in system frequency, to contain and correct frequency deviations.

label: Reserve
definition: Extra active power, or a reduction, that the system operator can call on over minutes to hours to restore the balance between supply and demand.

label: Thermal constraint management
definition: Actions that keep power flows within the thermal limits of network circuits or boundaries, at transmission or distribution level.

label: Voltage
definition: Absorbing or injecting reactive power to keep network voltages within their allowed range.

label: Stability
definition: Services that help the system ride through disturbances, such as inertia and short-circuit level.

label: Restoration
definition: Capability to restore electricity supplies after a total or partial shutdown of the system.

label: Capacity adequacy
definition: Making sure enough reliable capacity is available to meet demand at times of system stress.

label: Investment support
definition: Encouraging investment in new low-carbon generation or storage by reducing long-term revenue risk.
